title: Leyline: KV Cache Directives for Agentic Inference
authors: Bole Ma; Jan Eitzinger; Harald Köstler
affiliations: Erlangen National High Performance Computing Center
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Agentic LLM conversations evolve through policy-driven editing (retried tool calls, dropped stale outputs, pivoted trajectories), breaking the append-only assumption behind prefix caching. No serving primitive lets a policy actively remove or replace a span of cached content, so production harnesses fall back to full re-prefill on every edit.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic LLM 的對話歷程會因策略驅動的編輯（重試失敗的 tool call、移除過時輸出、轉向軌跡）而變動，破壞 prefix caching 所依賴的 append-only 假設。現有服務堆疊缺乏讓策略主動移除或替換快取內容區段的原語，生產環境的 agentic harness 只能在每次編輯時退回完整 re-prefill。

key_innovation.en: A declarative (span, replacement) directive interface with declared semantic modes (AMORTIZE in-place splice vs FORGET prefix-trimmed re-prefill): the policy declares what to edit, and a serving-side kernel restores attention-math correctness via a closed-form δ-rotation of downstream MLA K_pe slots, composed with a radix-cache integration that preserves the unchanged prefix subtree across the edit.
key_innovation.zh: 宣告式 (span, replacement) directive 介面，並附帶宣告的語意模式（in-place splice 的 AMORTIZE 與 prefix-trimmed re-prefill 的 FORGET）：策略只宣告要編輯什麼，服務端 kernel 以封閉式 δ-rotation 重新定位下游 slot 的 MLA K_pe，恢復 attention 數學正確性，並與 radix cache 整合，使未編輯的 prefix 子樹在編輯後仍得以保留。

key_improvements.en: Splice kernel lifts replay cache-hit rate by +11.2 pp over the standard radix baseline and cuts p50 end-to-end latency by up to 241 ms at C=8; a ten-line truncation policy routed through the same interface lifts agentic solve rate by +14.3 pp (31.2% → 45.5%) on debug-gym tasks.
key_improvements.zh: splice kernel 使 replay cache-hit 率較標準 radix baseline 提升 +11.2 pp，並在 C=8 時將 p50 端到端延遲最多降低 241 ms；經同一介面路由的十行 truncation policy 使 debug-gym agentic 任務解題率提升 +14.3 pp（31.2% → 45.5%）。

gpu_count: 1-4x GPUs per config (4x H200 TP=4; 2x H100; 1x H100)
